attchmntText: Gujarat Raffia Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Raffia Industries Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12 November 2026. Net profit for the quarter was 146.27 lakh rupees. Revenue from operations was 1164.31 lakh rupees. Earnings per share was 2.71 rupees. The trading window is closed until 48 hours after the declaration of results. The statutory auditors, M/s KPSJ Associates and LLP, issued a limited review report. The report states nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatement. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 were 2717.09 lakh rupees. Total equity was 2415.68 lakh rupees. Net cash flow from operating activities was 156.35 lakh rupees. Net cash used in investing activities was 466.75 lakh rupees. Net cash used in financing activities was 81.50 lakh rupees.
